## Before review

- [ ] **Layer stated, with the reasoning for that classification** — not just the label
- [ ] **Filed at the path the layer requires** (`policies/{area}/policy.md`, `policies/{area}/rule-*.md`, `rules/rule-*.md`, `constitution.md`, `exp-` prefix for experiments)
- [ ] **`Observed by:` line present** if this creates any enforceable duty, and honest about what would reasonably become known
- [ ] **Experiments** carry hypothesis, success criteria, end date, and the default that operates on expiry
- [ ] **Conflicts checked** against `rules/`, `policies/`, `constitution.md`, open pull requests, open issues, branches, and the organisation's other repositories — anything superseded is named
- [ ] **Thresholds computed** from the current `members.md`, fractions rounded up
- [ ] **Dates and arithmetic checked**, not recalled
- [ ] **Cross-references resolve** — every section cited exists
- [ ] **No authority claimed that the Charter reserves** to the College
- [ ] **No personal data** — no contact details, nothing identifying about guests or non-members
- [ ] **Reasoning is in a companion `rationale.md`**, not in the operative instrument
- [ ] Provisional numbers marked provisional

## Amendment record

<!-- Required by Constitution §1 for amendments to the Constitution and to rules. -->

- **How it was made:** <!-- consent / lazy consensus / majority / supermajority vote -->
- **Assumptions it rests on:**
- **Status:** <!-- live / experimental / archived -->
- **Explanatory notes from the discussion:**
- **Abstentions or objections:** <!-- in aggregate where the ballot was anonymous -->

## Process

- [ ] Deliberation period elapsed, **verified in the governance channel as well as here** — absence of objection on this pull request is not proof of lazy consensus
- [ ] Endorsements obtained where the layer requires them
- [ ] **Merged by a Record Keeper who is not the author**
